content.user_title: Draft Internal Communications in Anthropic Style
content.value_statement: Teams often need clear internal updates, but each format requires a different structure. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code templates for 3P updates, newsletters, FAQ answers, and general company messages.
actual_capabilities: Selects guideline files for 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQ responses, and general messages.
Structures 3P updates into Progress, Plans, and Problems sections.
Drafts company newsletters with concise bullets and impact-based sections.
Formats company FAQ answers as question and answer pairs.
Prompts for audience, purpose, tone, and formatting when the request is unclear.
Suggests using available Slack, email, calendar, and document context when the user grants access.
limitations: Does not verify factual claims unless the user provides sources or enabled tools.
Can expose sensitive internal details if users provide content that should not be shared.
Does not include company-specific approval workflows or legal review.
Uses example formats only; it does not enforce brand governance automatically.

use_cases.title: Align Weekly Team Updates
use_cases.description: Engineering managers can turn rough notes into a concise 3P update for leaders and cross-functional partners.

use_cases.title: Prepare Company Newsletters
use_cases.description: Comms teams can organize executive notes, milestones, and links into a company-wide Slack or email update.

use_cases.title: Reduce Repeated Questions
use_cases.description: People teams can convert common employee questions into clear FAQ answers with source links.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a 3P Update
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner team status update from notes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a 3P update for the {team_name} team for {date_range}. Use these notes: {notes}. Keep each section to 1-3 sentences.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Company Newsletter
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate company-wide update from approved topics.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a company newsletter for {date_range}. Use these approved topics and links: {source_notes}. Group related updates into clear sections.

prompt_templates.title: Answer Employee FAQs
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate FAQ response for recurring employee questions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write FAQ answers for these employee questions: {questions}. Use only these source notes: {source_notes}. Flag any answer that needs executive input.

prompt_templates.title: Synthesize Cross-Source Update
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced leadership update from multiple approved sources.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a leadership-ready internal update from Slack notes, document links, meeting summaries, and email excerpts. Separate facts, planned actions, and open questions.

output_examples.input: A product team shares rough weekly notes about launched features, next work, and customer blockers.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a short 3P update with Progress, Plans, and Problems sections, each written for quick leadership review.

output_examples.input: An internal communications lead provides newsletter topics, executive announcements, and approved source links.
output_examples.output: The skill creates grouped newsletter bullets, highlights company-wide impact, and keeps each item concise for Slack and email.

output_examples.input: A people team sends recurring employee questions about a policy change.
output_examples.output: The skill drafts question and answer pairs, cites official notes, and marks unclear topics for follow-up.

best_practices: Provide time period, audience, and desired channel before drafting.
Share source links or approved notes for factual claims.
Review drafts for confidentiality and approval requirements before sending.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent metrics, links, or leadership decisions.
Do not use broad connector access without a clear audience and scope.
Do not publish outputs before checking sensitive or restricted information.

faq.question: What communication formats does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQ responses, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, and incident reports.

faq.question: Can it use Slack or email context?
faq.answer: Yes, when the host tool grants access. Users should confirm scope and avoid sharing restricted information.

faq.question: Does it send messages automatically?
faq.answer: No. It drafts content and suggests structure. A user must review and send the final message.

faq.question: Is it specific to Anthropic?
faq.answer: It follows the included internal communication examples. Teams can adapt the prompts to their own company style.

faq.question: Can Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should users provide?
faq.answer: Users should provide audience, time period, source notes, links, desired tone, and any approval requirements.
